Container.Name: TheOpenSourceWeddingPlanner
Container.Overview: The Open Source Wedding Planner - a self-hosted web app to organize every detail of your wedding including ceremony, reception, guests, budget, vendors, seating, registry, and more.
Container.Description: The Open Source Wedding Planner is a comprehensive, self-hosted wedding planning application. Manage your ceremony timeline, reception details, guest list and RSVPs, budget tracking, vendor coordination, seating arrangements, registry, bridal party, honeymoon planning, and much more - all from a single app with no cloud dependency.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: wedding planner event organizer ceremony reception guest list budget
